paragraphs.text: Project Larkspur is a Netherlands-headquartered provider of fleet maintenance scheduling software, sold as a subscription to around 1,400 fleet operators in nine European countries.
FY2025 revenue was EUR 92m, of which 78% was recurring subscription and support revenue.

facts.basis: subscription and support as share of total revenue

paragraphs.text: Adjusted EBITDA for FY2025 was EUR 26m, after management adjustments for one-off restructuring costs and EUR 2.5m of pro forma savings from a planned office consolidation.
Net revenue retention across the customer base was 112% in FY2025, driven by module upsell and annual price indexation.
Management sees growth from expanding into predictive maintenance and from price increases on legacy contracts.
